description: Browse the current HHS-OIG Corporate Integrity Agreement roster by status — e.g. list every currently Suspended or Refused-by-Entity agreement. Reads the baked CIA list (refreshed periodically; data_as_of says when) rather than live detail pages, so it is fast but does not include effective dates/terms/documents — call oig_cia_check for those on a specific entity. Sourced from HHS-OIG, keyless.

status.description: Filter to one status: Effective, Suspended, Closed, or Refused. Omit to list all.

name: oig_cia_list
